statement: Participant membership does not imply authority.
Required participation does not imply authority.
Role assignment does not imply authority assignment.
Authority is relational to proposal, action, scope, and time.
Authority completeness requires satisfaction of every applicable required authority requirement.
Delegated authority cannot exceed upstream authority.
Expired or stale authority cannot satisfy a current requirement.
Authority conflict cannot be resolved solely by majority, consensus, validator count, execution order, or possession.
Authority completeness does not imply admissibility.
ParticipationComplete != AuthorityComplete != Agreement != Consensus != Admissible != Executed != Final.
